pbp08_protection_mismatch_window_split_e.notes: Leave-one-out marginal of pbp08_protection_mismatch_tilt inside the played 9-member card (marginal_ids = tilt's own flips minus the union of the other eight served members), split at week<=4 because WINDOW_GAMES=4/MIN_WINDOW_OBS=3 makes weeks 1-4 the only weeks whose 4-game pressure window can include a prior-season game (measured: 54/54 early flags and 21/21 early flips relied on a prior-season game in the flagged team's window).
